inputs.objective: Independently validate the large-distribution due-bill entitlement mechanism at documentary and implementability level only. Verify rule applicability, entitlement clock, event mapping and the distinction between ordinary and when-issued/ex-distribution claims without reading prices or returns.

allowed_actions: read the frozen hypothesis and pinned Legacy ledger
verify primary FINRA, SEC issuer and exchange documents for due-bill treatment and event clocks
assess security/CUSIP/when-issued mapping, entitlement semantics, settlement/broker constraints and PIT source quality
persist one EvidenceAssessment with PASS_TO_TEST_DESIGN, PARK_DATA or KILL_MECHANISM recommendation
forbidden_actions: read candidate event prices or returns
optimize distribution-size threshold, timing or instrument selection against outcomes
success_condition: One independent documentary EvidenceAssessment determines whether EVENT-DUEBILL-LARGE-DIST-001 is test-design ready, data-blocked or structurally invalid, without outcome access.
